scientific limitations/integrity: The displayed exact polynomial is a specialization of the published general join formula; originality is claimed only for the all-parameter unimodality theorem for generalized windmills. The theorem is restricted to equal petal sizes and does not assert log-concavity, real-rootedness, or an unequal-petal extension. Novelty is best-of-knowledge after targeted checks of the defining 2024 paper, a 2026 explicit-formula follow-up, and searches for windmill, friendship, clique-star, and block-graph formulations. A standalone exact small-case checker and finite arithmetic sweep support reproducibility. No independent audit, formal proof, or expert attestation has been performed.
title: Unimodality of general position polynomials for generalized windmill graphs
